title: Decision: unbound Chat of a hosted room has name empty
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 (cefc217) L251: the server sets Chat.name to the room_name 'when it knows it' and to the empty string otherwise. Showing the hub's current room_name after the user left leaks later renames to an ex-member. Options: current name, freeze at leave, empty. Chosen (Mark, 2026-10-19): empty string while the user has no current membership in the room; the name returns on rejoin. Followed (non-hosted) rooms stay empty as before (.12.25).
